displayedInputs.question:
A rectangular sheet of paper \(ABCD\) has \(AB=8\) and \(BC=10\) (the vertices are in the order \(A,B,C,D\)). Fold it along \(AE\) so that point \(D\) lands exactly at point \(F\) on side \(BC\), with point \(E\) on \(CD\). Find the length of \(CE\).

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

One diagonal of a rectangle has length \(10\). How long is the other diagonal? (Enter only the number.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

In rectangle \(ABCD\), \(AB=5\) and \(AD=3\). Fold along \(AE\) so that \(B\) lands at point \(F\) on side \(CD\). Find \(CF\). (\(E\) lies on \(BC\); enter only the length of \(CF\).)

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

Fold a rectangular sheet of paper \(ABCD\) along \(AE\) (\(E\) lies on side \(BC\)), so that point \(B\) lands at point \(F\). If \(\angle BAE=25^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle BEF\) in degrees.

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

The radius of \(\odot O\) is \(5\), and chord \(AB=8\). What is the distance from the center to \(AB\)?

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

What is the lateral surface area of a cone with base radius 3 and slant height 5? (The area can be written in the form \(k\pi\); enter only the value of \(k\).)

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

The lateral surface of a cone unfolds into a sector. Which of the following statements is correct?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

choices.A: The sector's radius equals the cone's base radius, and the sector's arc length equals the slant height.
choices.B: The sector's radius equals the cone's height, and the sector's arc length equals the radius of the base circle.
choices.C: The sector's radius equals the cone's slant height, and the sector's arc length equals the circumference of the cone's base circle.
